title: American Greed
description:
S10 E13 — The Bad Neighbors
A neighborhood ice cream parlor in West Roxbury, Mass., lands the Palladino family in a major case of fraud.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E12 — Jamaican Lottery Scam
U.S. law enforcement teams up with Jamaican authorities to stop criminals using call centers in Jamaica to flood the U.S. with lies about lottery millions won by unsuspecting victims.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E7 — Sick Profits; Hollywood Swinging
A mother and son score millions in the Bay Medical Clinic scam; Gigapix collects millions from would-be movie producers before being revealed as a fraud.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — We Fight
Indiana's Wabash Valley Correctional Facility is an isolated fortress with three officers for every 200 inmates; some inmates find themselves in racial conflict, while others seek conflict elsewhere.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Da Future
With over 2,000 inmates, the Wabash Valley Correctional Facility has a larger population and more acreage than the small town in which it's located; after a decade in confinement, one of Indiana's most infamous inmates moves to general population.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Father Figure
The killer of a corrections officer fights to be freed from 16 years of solitary confinement, and boyhood friends struggle to parent their kids from behind prison walls; but one, cut-off from visits with his son, is on a razor's edge.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Outlaws and In-Laws
Five miles from the riverfront hotels and restaurants of Savannah, Georgia, is a more ominous site, a place where an inmate is severely injured, and a friendship is torn; two soon to be brothers-in-law are accused of double homicide.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Wis-Dumb
A planned romantic weekend turns into a nightmare for one young couple; a fight sends two women to segregation, and for one of the combatants, the isolation takes its toll.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Message in a Bottle
A jailhouse assault leads to one bloody inmate, and two sides to the story; another inmate makes a daring escape; one of the jail's most violent inmates decides it's time for a change.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E19 — Follow the Juul Money
When an epidemic of teenage nicotine addiction breaks out across the country, some people ask whether Juul's founders are intent on saving lives or targeting the next generation.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E18 — Fraud Collectors
Memorabilia legend Bill Mastro helps turn a childhood hobby into a billion-dollar business and rigs bids to scam collectors and sellers.

title: American Greed
description:
S8 E8 — Extreme Home Ripoffs; Greedings From Florida
Two scheming brothers use a home remodeling business to rip off millions of dollars from Chicago homeowners; a scam artist tricks Florida retirees into investing in fake New York real estate.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Sucker Punch
After an inmate is assaulted, the jail identifies a suspect, but the violence doesn't stop there; a young inmate gets a crash course on how to survive in jail, as he prepares to deal with the consequences of his actions.
